note: D44: what an engine must implement for each event in poi-archetypes events{}. Every event has one SHAPE (its engine semantics) and one SCOPE: BATTLE (inside a battle map; may appear in an allocate eventDeck), OVERWORLD (world calendar / board only; never sent to a battle), or BOTH. Common fields on every event: src, teleSec (≥ 0, the telegraph), durSec (≥ 0), who.

SPAWN_WAVE.means: a hostile band spawns and fights `who` for durSec

BOSS.means: a champion appears or an existing unit empowers

HAZARD.means: an area effect that hits both sides

CONTEST.means: first side to hold the spot uncontested for holdToClaimSec wins it

ESCAPE.means: a runner tries to leave the map; catch it before escapeU

ESCORT.means: a caravan crosses the map: escorts protect, raiders take the cargo

TRIGGER.means: a state change with no units of its own (a banner, a wake)

MARKET.means: an overworld transaction (auction), never in a battle

KRAKEN_SIGHTING.note: in battle: a telegraphed strike on SHIPS; on the overworld: a lane sighting
